## About
Neat Auto Body & Detail is a family-run shop in Kissimmee owned by Mariano Alamo and Raquel Valentin. We do collision repair, auto paint and car detailing for all makes and models.
Nobody likes being in an accident. Our goal is to get your car back looking like it did before, or better. We work with an on-site spray booth and high quality paint and materials.
Customers rate us 4.8 on Google from 39 reviews. Ask your neighbors in Kissimmee, then come see us.

## Services
- Collision repair: Full-service collision repair for all makes and models, handled by our auto body technicians and paint specialists.
- Frame repairs: Structural damage after an accident is something our frame repair team handles.
- Body repairs: We roll fenders, fix dents and repair glass.
- Car repaint: Repaints done in our on-site spray booth with high quality auto paint and materials.
- Car detailing: Detail work including rubber mat cleaning, wheel cleaning and odor removal.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Bring your car by the shop or call us to set up a free estimate.

Q: Can you work with my insurance company?
A: A reviewer told us we dealt with her insurance directly when it was needed. Ask us about your claim when you come in.

Q: Can I get a ride while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes, we offer courtesy transportation within the local area.
